reconstruction_summary: Re-ran agent's declared best variant V2 (linear single-track yaw-rate gain via triage.linear_st_yaw_rate using platform priors from PARAM_BY_PLATFORM) plus a per-segment yaw-gyro bias = mean(meas - V0_pred) over straight samples (|delta_road|<0.01), matching the recipe in tools/run_ladder.py.
notes: V2 prior C_alpha values are platform-specific; for FORD_MUSTANG_MACH_E_MK1 used (C_af=286551, C_ar=355912) and for FORD_F_150_LIGHTNING_MK1 used (C_af=378307, C_ar=469878) from parameters.py PARAM_BY_PLATFORM. REPORT.md cites C_af=C_ar=1.5e5 but the script run_ladder.py and the v0_grade output use the platform priors; the script wins. Bias is computed per-segment from straight samples (|delta|<0.01) using meas - V0_pred (equivalent to using the stock residual column). Below v_min=2 m/s the ST falls back to KS internally.
